Class_Skill_Desc_Occult Comet: Deals unaspected damage with a potency of 500 to target and all enemies nearby it.</br>Potency scales with item level.
Class_Skill_Desc_Occult Dispel: Removes one beneficial status from target, with some exceptions.
Class_Skill_Desc_Occult Mage Masher: Lowers target's magic attack power by 10%.</br>Duration: 60s
Class_Skill_Desc_Occult Quick: Reduces weaponskill cast time and recast time, spell cast time and recast time, and auto-attack delay of self or target party member by 10%, and reduces cast times for spells by 10 seconds.</br>Duration: 20s</br>Additional Effect: Greatly increases movement speed</br>Duration: 10s
Class_Skill_Desc_Occult Slowga: Afflicts target and all enemies nearby it with Slow +80%.</br>Duration: 30s
